counters.rationale: Early settlement at 0.85% is cheaper than financing the invoice on the marginal committed source; the line covers the rest of the near-term gap.
counters.formula: break-even: d/(1−d) < c, c = 10.8417% × 30/365 = 0.8911% → d < 0.8832%; largest whole-5bp rate below it = 0.85%. Cost: discount ¥2,210.00 + funding the rest of the gap ¥825.99 (committed plan: ¥825.99) = ¥3,035.99
